uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: After using a move: increases movement speed by 50% for 2s (decaying by 5% every 0.25s). Increases movement speed by 10% while near an ally Latias. When not in combat, this Ability can be used to fly to an allied Latias. This Ability goes on cooldown for 90s after it's triggered for both Latios and Latias. While channeling this ability the user can move around, once the 2s channel is completed the user becomes unstoppable and flies to where Latias was when this ability was activated. If Latias is at home base, the cooldown of Levitate will go down twice as fast for Latios.
Shoots a psychic projectile at an opposing Pokémon, damaging them. Latios has no boosted attack.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.
Releases a weak telekinetic force in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and decreasing their movement speed by 20% for 2s.

Lets loose a ball of light that moves in the designated direction. When used again (automatically after 0.85s): releases the ball's light all at once, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect; and marking them for 3s. This move then goes on cooldown. Latios and any allied Latias deal 20% increased damage to marked opposing Pokémon. This mark can be cleansed.

Unleashes psychic power in the designated direction, damaging the first opposing Pokémon hit, decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s; and marking the target for 4s. This move may be used again afterwards. When used again: unleashes psychic power at the designated opposing Pokémon, decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s when it hits. This move goes on cooldown when the mark is consumed or cleansed. If the target of the second use is already marked by the first use or the first use missed: stuns that target for 1s when the psychic power hits, consuming the mark. If the target of the second use is a different, unmarked opposing Pokémon: the two targets are pulled a set distance toward each other over 0.7s. The two Pokémon are stunned for 1s while being pulled together. If they collide with one another, they are thrown away from each other and their marks are consumed.
Strengthened movement speed decrease duration to 3s.
Shoots star-shaped rays in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect.

After learning this move: Latios gains 2 Eon power for knocking out a wild Pokémon; or 3 Eon power per Pokémon from the opposing team hit by this move's boosted attack. When this move is used: Latios dashes forward, empowering the next basic attack used within 5s to be a special boosted attack that hits in a straight line, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. The move goes on cooldown when the boosted attack is used or after 5s. This move gains 2 telekinetic projectiles at 25 and 100 Eon power, and gains 1 projectile at 50 and 75 Eon power for a total of 6 projectiles. Subsequent projectiles hitting the same target deal 15% less damage; further decreasing with each projectile to a maximum of 75% less damage. For every 1 Eon power accumulated beyond 100; the projectile damage increases by 0.5% (Eon power caps at 1099).
The telekinetic projectiles deal an additional 3% missing HP damage to the target. Against any opposing Pokémon: additional missing HP damage is capped at 300 per projectile.

After learning this move: Latios gains 2 Eon power for knocking out a wild Pokémon; or 3 Eon power per Pokémon from the opposing team hit during this move. When this move is used: 2 comets crash onto the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect with each comet. This move gains 1 additional comet for every 25 Eon power accumulated, with a maximum of 6 comets at 100 Eon power. Subsequent comets that hit the same target deal 50% less damage. For every 1 Eon power accumulated beyond 100: increases comet damage by 0.5% (Eon power caps at 1099).
Comets deal an additional 3% missing HP damage to opposing Pokémon hit. Against any opposing Pokémon: additional missing HP damage is capped at 300 per comet.

Aims at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team and charges power for 1.8s before releasing a pulse, damaging all opposing Pokémon hit. Resets move cooldowns immediately after releasing the pulse, and increases cooldown reduction to 60% for 9.5s. If Latias is also aiming its Unite Move at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, the pulses stack and explode, dealing damage around the target as well. If Eon Blast hits last then the explosion uses Latios' stats.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

source.name: Levitate
source.originalDescription: After using a move: increases movement speed by 50% for 2s (decaying by 5% every 0.25s). Increases movement speed by 10% while near an ally Latias. When not in combat, this Ability can be used to fly to an allied Latias. This Ability goes on cooldown for 90s after it's triggered for both Latios and Latias. While channeling this ability the user can move around, once the 2s channel is completed the user becomes unstoppable and flies to where Latias was when this ability was activated. If Latias is at home base, the cooldown of Levitate will go down twice as fast for Latios.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Levitate は 妨害無効になる、移動速度を上げる、次の通常攻撃または強化攻撃を準備する。
